name: Caer Idris

attributes.attribute: night in it brought madness or poetry

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Caer Idris is a Welsh mythological site. A formation of rock stands on a mountain in Merionethshire. The rock has a reputation for magical power. The formation includes a stone chair. Anyone who passed the night in that chair met the dawn either insane or inspired with poetry.

okr.objective: Caer Idris is a magical rock site on a Welsh mountain.
key_results: A rock formation crowns a mountain in Merionethsshire.
The rocks are credited with magical power.
A night in the stone chair leaves one mad or inspired.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore
